name: wifiplus
description: WifiPlus — real browser-based internet measurement. Repo root: the deployed static site plus scripts that drive the sub-projects.

scripts.//: The repo root IS the static site — index.html, app.js and the generated SEO pages are served as-is with no build step, which is why `dev` just serves the folder. The Next.js app, the measurement engine, the edge server and the Worker each have their own package.json; the scripts below are shortcuts into them so you never have to remember which directory you are supposed to be in.
scripts.build: npm run build:seo && npm run build:og
scripts.check: npm run check:core && npm run check:web && npm run check:static && npm run check:shell && npm run check:seo
scripts.check:core: npm --prefix core run typecheck && npm --prefix core test
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.check:static: node --check app.js && node --check sw.js && node --check landing.js && node --check boot-check.js
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix core install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix server install
